The pattern is consistent: start with an affordable QA tool, hit the scale wall at 2,000-5,000 test cases, migrate to an enterprise platform.

The migration is painful. The enterprise platform is expensive. The team spends six months rebuilding what they had.

TestFiesta was built to break that pattern. The platform stays fast as test suites grow. And for teams that need CI/CD integration and headless access, the Taco Truck CLI provides enterprise-grade automation at $10/user/month.

Where affordable tools break: slow list views at 5,000+ test cases, unreliable bulk operations, filter performance degradation, attachment storage limits. All architectural decisions made early or not at all.
TestFiesta: paginated list views with instant search, async bulk operations (no timeouts), efficient multi-project management, CDN-served attachments. Designed for scale from the start.

The Taco Truck CLI: open-source CLI for CI/CD integration, automated result reporting, bulk imports. Accepts JUnit XML, TestNG XML, JSON. Native integrations for GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, GitLab CI.

Install: npm install -g @fiestatools/tacotruck or brew install fiestatools/tacotruck/tacotruck. Full docs: github.com/fiestatools/tacotruck. Full scale guide: testfiesta.com/blog/test-management-at-scale
